thread:
devon.patel: Postmortem follow-up: uncovered several recurring auth/security gaps — want to spin a focused remediation epic. TL;DR: token TTL drift, missing S2S audit lines, secrets-rotation leftovers, and a permissions propagation bug. thoughts?
katie.h: Thanks. Can we group by impact+effort? which ones are urgent for prod risk?
lee.t: Quick categorize: TTL drift -> causes intermittent 401 storms (prod-visible), secrets leftovers -> risk of long-lived creds, missing audit -> compliance hole (SOC), permissions propagation -> scope creep for admin role.
samir: Agree with Lee. Recommend urgent = TTL drift + secrets leftovers. Audit + perms are high-priority but can be handled in parallel.
devon.patel: Proposal: 10-working-day remediation sprint. Owners: TTL -> samir, secrets -> lee.t, audit -> katie.h, perms -> devon.patel. Each owner to publish a short mitigation plan and rollback steps. Acks?
samir: ack. My plan: standardize TTL precedence across services and add runtime validation so services emit a warning metric when token TTL mismatch occurs. will feature-flag the change.
lee.t: ack. I'll harden rotation job to sweep stale items and add idempotent cleanup; will also add a verification probe that queries Vault+cache after rotation.
katie.h: ack. I'll implement a light audit shim to backfill missing S2S events for the last 120 days and add unit + integration queries for regression detection.
devon.patel: Good. I'll own the permissions migration script and coordinate with product for low-traffic window. Also will update the incident runbook.
ops-bot: Reminder set: remediation-sprint-kickoff -> 2026-04-03T15:00:00Z.
katie.h: Milestone suggestion:
- day 1-3: TTL fix + feature flag (samir)
- day 4-6: secrets sweep + probe (lee.t)
- day 4-8: audit shim + backfill (katie.h)
- day 6-10: perms migration + canary (devon.patel)
- day 10: e2e verification & compliance signoff
samir: For TTL fix, I'll add a compatibility layer to avoid client breakage and a metric: "auth.ttl.mismatch.count". snippet i'm planning: 
```go
// resolvedTTL returns canonical > service > fallback
func resolvedTTL(cfg Config) time.Duration {
  if cfg.Canonical > 0 { return cfg.Canonical }
  if cfg.ServiceOverride > 0 { return cfg.ServiceOverride }
  return cfg.Default
}
```
lee.t: For the rotation sweep, i'll run dry-run + cleanup mode. Need a harness to generate stale creds for tests. samir, can you add a test env token with short TTL so we can validate the probe?
samir: yes, I'll provision test tokens and a watch metric.
devon.patel: I've added these actions to the postmortem tracker. Checklist for copy/paste: 
```
- [ ] Standardize token TTL precedence + metric (owner: samir) - due 2026-04-07
- [ ] TTL feature flag + canary rollout (owner: samir) - due 2026-04-08
- [ ] Secrets rotation: sweep & verification probe (owner: lee.t) - due 2026-04-10
- [ ] Audit shim + backfill for S2S events (owner: katie.h) - due 2026-04-09
- [ ] Permission propagation migration + tests (owner: devon.patel) - due 2026-04-11
- [ ] End-to-end verification + SOC signoff (owner: katie.h) - due 2026-04-13
```

katie.h: Also adding a quarterly "token health" check to the security calendar to detect drift earlier.
devon.patel: ops-bot, please add recurring task: token-health-audit every 90 days assigned to security team.
ops-bot: Recurring task created: token-health-audit -> every 90 days, owners: [katie.h, samir].
lee.t: One more note: perms migration should include a rollback plan that rebinds older role states if we see elevated errors. I'll draft a cutoff monitor.
samir: i'll open PRs and link them here as they land. please tag me for code review on TTL changes.
katie.h: i'll prepare audit queries for regression checks and a SOC-ready report template.
devon.patel: Cool. Short sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to triage any blockers pre-sprint. Thanks all. :rocket:
